observations.name: Gloo AI Hackathon 2026

facts.eligibility: Ages 18+; all experience levels and professional/academic backgrounds welcome, subject to organizer registration/acceptance.
facts.format: In-person AI hackathon; 2026 theme Build Together: Humans, Agents, and the Future of Flourishing; organizer says challenges are live and 30-day build window is open.
facts.prize_evidence: USD 200,000 in cash prizes advertised by organizer.
facts.authorization_boundary: Build competition only. Public Gloo systems, APIs, repositories, partner systems, user data, or third-party services are not security-testing targets.

missing_verification: Complete governing rules and exact cash-prize allocation by challenge/placement.

Submission requirements, judging criteria, originality/pre-existing-work rules, permitted AI/tool/data policy, and IP/publicity terms.
Travel/lodging responsibility and any reimbursement or attendance conditions for the Boulder event.

observations.deduplication: No Gloo AI Hackathon item was identified in current-main code search or inspected open research PR titles/bodies. Treat this as contributed research until canonical chronology reaches Sep. 28.
observations.recommended_next_action: When chronologically eligible, reopen the organizer rules/registration/challenge surfaces, preserve complete prize and participation terms, and create a structured build-competition case only if attendance/participation is intended and accepted.
